name: Bench Press (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Bench Press (hantle), Machine Chest Press, Push Up; Smith bench press
note: Bench inside a rack or a bench with its own uprights; safeties/spotter recommended.

name: Bench Press (hantle)
alternativesNote: Bench Press (sztanga), Machine Chest Press, Push Up

name: Incline Bench Press (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Incline Bench Press (hantle); Smith incline press; incline machine press
note: Incline bench inside a rack, or a dedicated incline station with uprights.

name: Incline Bench Press (hantle)
alternativesNote: Incline Bench Press (sztanga); Smith incline press; Incline Push Up is a much easier bodyweight option

name: Decline Bench Press
alternativesNote: Chest Dip, Bench Press (sztanga); decline DB press; Machine Chest Press
note: Name has no implement; barbell per app class. Decline DB press would need db + bench.decline instead.

name: Chest Fly (hantle)
alternativesNote: Cable Fly, Pec Deck
note: Incline variant would need bench.incline.

name: Cable Fly
alternativesNote: Pec Deck, Chest Fly (hantle); band fly
note: Any pulley height (high-to-low, mid, low-to-high). Single-arm version possible on one pulley.

name: Pec Deck
alternativesNote: Cable Fly, Chest Fly (hantle)
note: Most pec-deck machines double as Reverse Pec Deck.

name: Machine Chest Press
alternativesNote: Bench Press (hantle/sztanga); Smith bench press; Push Up
note: Some chest-press machines are plate-loaded; machine_stack chosen as the common case.

name: Wyciskanie na linkach (stojąc)
alternativesNote: Cable Fly, Machine Chest Press, Push Up; band chest press
note: PL: standing cable chest press. Assumed two handles from two pulleys at ~chest height; a single-arm version on one mid pulley is possible.

name: Chest Dip
alternativesNote: Triceps Dips (ławka), Decline Bench Press, Push Up; assisted dip machine
note: Rings, power tower or rack dip attachment also work (rings change the feel). Band assistance is optional (not required); dip_belt only for weighted variant.

name: Push Up
alternativesNote: Bench Press (hantle), Machine Chest Press, Incline Push Up
note: Floor only. Parallettes / vest / plate on back optional.

name: Incline Push Up
alternativesNote: Push Up, Bench Press (hantle), Machine Chest Press
note: Hands on any sturdy elevated surface (bench, box, chair, counter, Smith/rack bar); wall push-up is the easiest extreme.

name: Diamond Push Up
alternativesNote: Close Grip Bench Press, Triceps Dips (ławka), Triceps Pushdown

name: Deadlift (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Trap Bar Deadlift, Deadlift (hantle), Sumo Deadlift
note: Lifting platform / bumper plates not modelled.

name: Deadlift (hantle)
alternativesNote: Deadlift (sztanga), Trap Bar Deadlift, Kettlebell Swing

name: Sumo Deadlift
alternativesNote: Deadlift (sztanga), Trap Bar Deadlift; DB/KB sumo deadlift
note: Name has no implement; barbell per app class.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
alternativesNote: Deadlift (sztanga), Deadlift (hantle)
note: App coarse class is 'sztanga' but the trap (hex) bar is a distinct implement. Squat-hinge hybrid; classed hinge.

name: RDL (sztanga)
alternativesNote: RDL (hantle/linki), Good Morning, Back Extension
note: Rack is a convenience for unracking at hip height; the bar can be deadlifted up first.

name: RDL (hantle/linki)
alternativesNote: RDL (sztanga), Good Morning, Back Extension
note: Two hands: two dumbbells OR two low cables / a bar on one low cable (cables: 2 = on a two-cable station). One-hand version: Single Arm RDL (hantel/linka) (owner decision 04.10.2026).

name: Bent Over Row (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Bent Over Row (hantle), Pendlay Row, T-Bar Row, Seated Cable Row

name: Bent Over Row (hantle)
alternativesNote: Bent Over Row (sztanga), One Arm Row (hantle), Chest Supported Row

name: Pendlay Row
alternativesNote: Bent Over Row (sztanga/hantle), T-Bar Row
note: Dead-stop barbell row from the floor.

name: One Arm Row (hantle)
alternativesNote: Bent Over Row (hantle), Chest Supported Row, single-arm Seated Cable Row
note: Classic version braced on a bench; can brace on a rack/knee, so bench only recommended.

name: Chest Supported Row
alternativesNote: Seated Cable Row, T-Bar Row; chest-supported row machine (row_machine)
note: Generic name; interpreted per app class as dumbbells lying chest-down on an incline bench. In gyms often done on a row_machine or chest-supported T-bar instead.

name: T-Bar Row
alternativesNote: Bent Over Row (sztanga), Chest Supported Row, Seated Cable Row
note: Either a T-bar row station or a barbell in a landmine: CNF of t_bar OR (landmine AND barbell). Barbell wedged into a corner works without a landmine. T-bar stations are plate-loaded; loadSource kept as barbell per app class.

name: Seated Cable Row
alternativesNote: One Arm Row (hantle), Bent Over Row, row_machine
note: Dedicated seated-row station, or any low pulley sitting on the floor/bench with feet braced.

name: Wiosłowanie na linkach (siedząc)
alternativesNote: One Arm Row (hantle), Bent Over Row, row_machine
note: PL: seated cable row with two hands on two cables (owner station); one-hand version: Single Arm Cable Row (owner decision 04.10.2026).

name: Lat Pulldown
alternativesNote: Pull Up, Chin Up, assisted_pullup_machine; band pulldown
note: Seated station with thigh pad; kneeling under any high pulley is an accepted substitute.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
alternativesNote: Lat Pulldown; band straight-arm pulldown; DB pullover
note: Lats isolation. A lat_pulldown station's pulley also serves (location side may map lat_pulldown -> cable.high).

name: Chin Up
alternativesNote: Lat Pulldown (underhand), Pull Up, assisted_pullup_machine
note: Rings / power tower also work (rings change the feel). Band assistance optional (not required).

name: Pull Up
alternativesNote: Lat Pulldown, Chin Up, assisted_pullup_machine
note: Rings / power tower also work (rings change the feel). Band assistance optional (not required).

name: Neutral Grip Pull Up
alternativesNote: Lat Pulldown (neutral handle), Pull Up, Chin Up, assisted_pullup_machine
note: Needs parallel/neutral handles (common on rack and power-tower bars, absent on many doorway bars); rings also give a neutral grip. No separate capability in vocab. Band assistance optional.

name: Inverted Row
alternativesNote: Bent Over Row (hantle), Seated Cable Row, One Arm Row (hantle)
note: Needs a bar/handles at hip height: barbell on rack hooks (rack AND barbell), Smith bar, rings or suspension trainer - written in CNF. At home a sturdy table edge also works (not in vocab).

name: Face Pull
alternativesNote: Reverse Pec Deck, Reverse Fly (hantle); band face pull (band.loop_anchor)
note: Rope attachment, pulley at face height or higher.

name: Back Extension
alternativesNote: RDL (sztanga), Good Morning; floor superman
note: 45 deg or 90 deg hyperextension bench, or a GHD. Optional plate/DB held for load.

name: Shrugs (hantle)
alternativesNote: Shrugs (sztanga), Farmer's Walk; trap-bar or Smith shrugs

name: Shrugs (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Shrugs (hantle), Farmer's Walk; trap-bar or Smith shrugs
note: Rack is a convenience for unracking at thigh height.

name: Good Morning
alternativesNote: RDL (sztanga), Back Extension; band good morning
note: Bar on the upper back must be unracked from shoulder height.

name: Overhead Press (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Overhead Press (hantle), Machine Shoulder Press, Push Press; Smith OHP
note: Normally unracked at shoulder height, but the bar can be cleaned from the floor, so rack only recommended (unlike squats/good morning).

name: Overhead Press (hantle)
alternativesNote: Overhead Press (sztanga), Seated Shoulder Press (hantle), Machine Shoulder Press
note: Standing.

name: Seated Shoulder Press (hantle)
alternativesNote: Overhead Press (hantle/sztanga), Arnold Press, Machine Shoulder Press
note: Any seat works; back support (adjustable bench set ~80-90 deg) recommended.

name: Arnold Press
alternativesNote: Seated Shoulder Press (hantle), Overhead Press (hantle)
note: Done seated (back support recommended) or standing.

name: Push Press
alternativesNote: Overhead Press (sztanga), DB push press
note: Same rack logic as Overhead Press (sztanga).

name: Machine Shoulder Press
alternativesNote: Overhead Press (hantle/sztanga), Seated Shoulder Press (hantle); Smith OHP
note: Some are plate-loaded; machine_stack chosen as the common case.

name: Wyciskanie nad głowę (linki)
alternativesNote: Overhead Press (hantle), Machine Shoulder Press; band overhead press
note: PL: cable overhead press. Assumed standing/kneeling between two low pulleys; a single-arm version on one low pulley is possible.

name: Lateral Raise (hantle)
alternativesNote: Cable Lateral Raise; machine lateral raise; band lateral raise

name: Cable Lateral Raise
alternativesNote: Lateral Raise (hantle); band lateral raise
note: Single-arm from a low pulley.

name: Front Raise
alternativesNote: Plate front raise (plates), cable front raise (cable.low), barbell front raise
note: Name has no implement; dumbbells per app class.

name: Reverse Fly (hantle)
alternativesNote: Reverse Pec Deck, Face Pull; cable rear-delt fly (cable.dual)
note: Bent-over or chest-down on an incline bench. Near-duplicate of 'Rear Delt Raise (hantle)' (both = bent-over DB rear-delt fly).

name: Reverse Pec Deck
alternativesNote: Reverse Fly (hantle), Face Pull; cable rear-delt fly (cable.dual)
note: Uses the pec_deck machine (most are dual-purpose); a dedicated rear-delt machine would also count.

name: Upright Row (hantle)
alternativesNote: Lateral Raise (hantle); barbell/EZ upright row; cable upright row (cable.low)
note: Name has no implement; dumbbells per app class. Compound delt/trap pull, classed isolation (sometimes v_pull).

name: Biceps Curl (hantle)
alternativesNote: Barbell Curl, EZ Bar Curl, Cable Curl, Hammer Curl

name: Barbell Curl
alternativesNote: EZ Bar Curl, Biceps Curl (hantle), Cable Curl

name: EZ Bar Curl
alternativesNote: Barbell Curl, Biceps Curl (hantle), Cable Curl
note: App coarse class is 'sztanga'; the EZ bar is a distinct implement.

name: Hammer Curl
alternativesNote: Rope cable hammer curl (cable.low), Biceps Curl (hantle)

name: Incline Curl (hantle)
alternativesNote: Biceps Curl (hantle), Cable Curl (behind body), Spider Curl
note: Seated back on an incline bench.

name: Concentration Curl (hantle)
alternativesNote: Preacher Curl, Spider Curl, single-arm Cable Curl
note: Seated; any seat works.

name: Preacher Curl
alternativesNote: Spider Curl, Concentration Curl (hantle); EZ-bar or machine preacher curl
note: Generic name; dumbbells per app class. Needs a preacher bench/pad; an incline-bench backrest is a common one-arm DB substitute (not encoded).

name: Spider Curl
alternativesNote: Preacher Curl, Concentration Curl (hantle)
note: Chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging.

name: Cable Curl
alternativesNote: Biceps Curl (hantle), Barbell Curl; band curl

name: Skullcrusher (hantle)
alternativesNote: Skullcrusher (EZ), Overhead Triceps Extension (hantel), Triceps Pushdown
note: Floor version possible but bench is standard.

name: Skullcrusher (EZ)
alternativesNote: Skullcrusher (hantle), Cable Overhead Extension, Triceps Pushdown
note: App coarse class is 'sztanga'; EZ bar named explicitly.

name: Triceps Dips (ławka)
alternativesNote: Chest Dip, Diamond Push Up, Triceps Pushdown
note: PL 'ławka' = bench: bench dips; a chair or box works.

name: Triceps Pushdown
alternativesNote: Band pushdown, Skullcrusher, Diamond Push Up
note: Rope or bar attachment.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (hantel)
alternativesNote: Cable Overhead Extension, Skullcrusher (hantle/EZ)
note: One dumbbell held with both hands (app SINGLE_IMPLEMENT); seated or standing.

name: Cable Overhead Extension
alternativesNote: Overhead Triceps Extension (hantel), Skullcrusher; band overhead extension
note: Facing away from a high pulley, or from a low pulley; rope attachment.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
alternativesNote: Diamond Push Up, Triceps Dips (ławka); close-grip DB press; Smith CGBP
note: Name has no implement; barbell per app class. Same setup as Bench Press (sztanga).

name: Triceps Kickback
alternativesNote: Triceps Pushdown; cable kickback (cable.low)
note: Bench support optional.

name: Back Squat
alternativesNote: Front Squat, Hack Squat, Leg Press, Goblet Squat; Smith squat

name: Front Squat
alternativesNote: Back Squat, Goblet Squat, Hack Squat; Smith front squat

name: Goblet Squat
alternativesNote: Back Squat, Front Squat, Leg Press, Przysiad z pasem (linki)
note: One DB or KB held at the chest (app SINGLE_IMPLEMENT); kettlebell is the classic implement so it is OR'ed in.

name: Przysiad z pasem (linki)
alternativesNote: Back Squat, Goblet Squat, Leg Press; belt-squat machine; landmine belt squat
note: PL: belt squat on cables - interpreted as a hip/dip belt clipped to a low pulley (standing on boxes optional). The belt is inherent to the exercise, so dip_belt is required. Dedicated belt-squat machine not in vocab.

name: Box Squat
alternativesNote: Back Squat; Goblet Squat to box
note: Box or bench behind as depth target.

name: Hack Squat
alternativesNote: Leg Press, Back Squat; Smith squat
note: Most hack squats are plate-loaded; some are selectorized.

name: Leg Press
alternativesNote: Hack Squat, Back Squat, Przysiad z pasem (linki)
note: Most leg presses are plate-loaded; some are selectorized.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (hantle)
alternativesNote: Lunges (hantle), Reverse Lunge, Step Up; barbell/Smith split squat
note: Rear foot on bench/box.

name: Lunges (hantle)
alternativesNote: Walking Lunges, Reverse Lunge, Bulgarian Split Squat (hantle); barbell lunge

name: Walking Lunges
alternativesNote: Lunges (hantle), Reverse Lunge, Bulgarian Split Squat (hantle)
note: App classes this as dumbbells, but the name has no implement and it is commonly done unloaded; requirement kept at the floor so it stays available everywhere (db recommended). Switch requires to [["db"]] if the app should treat it as always loaded. Needs walking space.

name: Reverse Lunge
alternativesNote: Lunges (hantle), Walking Lunges, Bulgarian Split Squat (hantle)
note: App classes this as dumbbells, but the name has no implement and it is commonly done unloaded; requirement kept at the floor so it stays available everywhere (db recommended). Switch requires to [["db"]] if the app should treat it as always loaded.

name: Step Up
alternativesNote: Bulgarian Split Squat (hantle), Lunges (hantle), Pistol Squat
note: Box/bench at about knee height. App classes this as dumbbells, but the name has no implement and it is commonly done unloaded; requirement kept at the floor so it stays available everywhere (db recommended). Switch requires to [["db"]] if the app should treat it as always loaded.

name: Leg Extension
alternativesNote: Sissy Squat; band leg extension; Front Squat

name: Leg Curl
alternativesNote: Lying Leg Curl, Nordic Curl, RDL (sztanga)
note: Generic name; presumably the seated machine (since 'Lying Leg Curl' is separate). Vocab has a single leg_curl capability, so a seated vs a lying leg-curl machine is not distinguished.

name: Lying Leg Curl
alternativesNote: Leg Curl, Nordic Curl; DB leg curl lying on a bench
note: Vocab has a single leg_curl capability, so a seated vs a lying leg-curl machine is not distinguished.

name: Nordic Curl
alternativesNote: Leg Curl, Lying Leg Curl, RDL (sztanga)
note: Needs an ankle anchor: GHD/GHR/Nordic bench, lat-pulldown thigh pad, or a loaded barbell over the heels. At home a sofa, partner or strap anchor - not expressible in vocab, so availability is under-reported. Band assistance optional.

name: Pistol Squat
alternativesNote: Bulgarian Split Squat (hantle), Step Up, Goblet Squat
note: Box/bench as depth target or support for regression; band assistance optional.

name: Sissy Squat
alternativesNote: Leg Extension, Front Squat
note: Hold a post/rack for balance; a sissy-squat bench is optional (not in vocab). Knee-dominant quad isolation; could be classed squat.

name: Wall Sit
alternativesNote: Goblet Squat, Leg Extension
note: Isometric (metric: time). Ściana zawsze dostępna — bez wymagań (przegląd 02.10).

name: Hip Thrust (sztanga)
alternativesNote: Hip Thrust (hantel), Glute Bridge; hip-thrust machine; Smith hip thrust
note: Upper back on bench/box; bar pad advised (not in vocab).

name: Hip Thrust (hantel)
alternativesNote: Hip Thrust (sztanga), Glute Bridge
note: One dumbbell on the hips (app SINGLE_IMPLEMENT).

name: Glute Bridge
alternativesNote: Hip Thrust (sztanga/hantel), Cable Kickback
note: Floor version; optional DB/plate/barbell on hips.

name: Cable Kickback
alternativesNote: Hip Thrust, Glute Bridge; band kickback
note: Ankle-strap attachment.

alternativesNote: Band lateral walk/clamshell; cable hip abduction (cable.low)

alternativesNote: Cable hip adduction (cable.low); Copenhagen plank

name: Kettlebell Swing
alternativesNote: RDL (hantle/linki), Hip Thrust, Deadlift (hantle)
note: App coarse class is 'hantle' (no KB class); DB swing is a common substitute, so db is OR'ed in.

name: Standing Calf Raise
alternativesNote: Łydki na stopniu, Calf Press (leg press); Smith or barbell calf raise
note: Name has no implement; machine per app class. Vocab has a single calf_machine capability; standing vs seated calf machine is not distinguished.

name: Seated Calf Raise
alternativesNote: Standing Calf Raise; DB on knees seated on a bench with toes on a step
note: Seated calf machines are usually plate-loaded. Vocab has a single calf_machine capability; standing vs seated calf machine is not distinguished.

name: Łydki na stopniu
alternativesNote: Standing Calf Raise, Calf Press (leg press)
note: Dowolny stopień/schody — bez wymagań, skrzynia zalecana (przegląd 02.10).

alternativesNote: Standing Calf Raise, Łydki na stopniu
note: Done on the leg press.

name: Plank

alternativesNote: Suitcase Carry, Pallof Press

alternativesNote: Dead Bug, Plank, Pallof Press
note: Anti-rotation / anti-extension.

name: Ab Wheel
alternativesNote: Plank; barbell rollout (barbell with round plates); suspension fallout

name: Pallof Press
alternativesNote: Band Pallof press (band.loop_anchor), Side Plank, Suitcase Carry
note: Band version is equally common but not OR'ed in (different load source); pulley at chest height.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
alternativesNote: Hanging Knee Raise, Reverse Crunch; captain's-chair raise (dip.bars)
note: Rings / power tower also work.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
alternativesNote: Hanging Leg Raise, Reverse Crunch; captain's-chair raise (dip.bars)
note: Rings / power tower also work.

name: Cable Crunch
alternativesNote: Crunch, Reverse Crunch, Hanging Leg Raise
note: Kneeling, rope attachment.

name: Crunch
alternativesNote: Cable Crunch, Reverse Crunch

name: Reverse Crunch
alternativesNote: Hanging Knee Raise, Crunch
note: Floor or on a flat bench.

name: Russian Twist
alternativesNote: Pallof Press; med-ball or plate twist
note: Rotation. One implement (app SINGLE_IMPLEMENT); med ball or plate equally common. name: Hollow Hold
alternativesNote: Plank, Dead Bug
note: Isometric (metric: time).

name: Farmer's Walk
alternativesNote: Suitcase Carry, Shrugs (hantle); trap-bar or KB carry
note: Needs walking space. Trap bar / kettlebells / farmer handles are substitutes (not OR'ed in).

name: Suitcase Carry
alternativesNote: Farmer's Walk, Side Plank; KB carry
note: One dumbbell (app SINGLE_IMPLEMENT); needs walking space.

name: Mountain Climbers
alternativesNote: Burpees, Plank
note: Conditioning (metric: time); could also be classed core_anti_ext.

name: Incline Walk (bieżnia)
alternativesNote: Bieg; stair climber (cardio.stairs); outdoor hill walk
note: PL 'bieżnia' = treadmill.

name: Bieg
alternativesNote: Incline Walk (bieżnia), Rower, Rowing Machine
note: Bieżnia albo bieg na zewnątrz — na zewnątrz zawsze możliwe, więc bez wymagań (przegląd 02.10).

name: Rower
alternativesNote: Assault Bike, Rowing Machine, Bieg

alternativesNote: Rower, Rowing Machine

name: Incline Chest Fly (hantle)

note: Bar end in a landmine; usually one arm at a time, load = plates on the bar.

name: Single Arm Overhead Press (hantel)
note: One dumbbell, one side at a time.

name: Cable Front Raise
note: Bar or rope on one low pulley.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
note: Crossed cables from two pulleys at shoulder height or above.

name: Cable Y Raise

name: Upright Row (linki)

name: Upright Row (sztanga)

note: Wrist extensors; forearms on a bench or thighs.

note: One handle on a high pulley.

note: One handle, bent over; low or mid pulley.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ)
note: Standing or seated with an EZ bar.

name: Skullcrusher (sztanga)

name: One-Arm Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
fedb: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
note: Lying one-arm extension, palm toward the feet.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
note: One-arm overhead extension, seated with back support or standing.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
note: One kettlebell held by the horns with both hands.

name: Standing Overhead Barbell Triceps Extension
note: Straight barbell, standing (EZ version = Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ)).

name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Kickback
fedb: Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
note: Two-arm kickback, bent over, no bench support.

name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
note: Incline bench facing away from a high pulley, straight bar overhead.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
note: Flat bench, head toward a low pulley; straight bar or rope.

name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
note: Bar on a high pulley, underhand grip.

name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
note: Kneeling facing away from a high pulley, elbows on a bench, straight bar overhead.

name: Standing Low-Pulley One-Arm Triceps Extension
note: One handle from a low pulley, one-arm overhead extension facing away.

name: Chain Handle Extension
note: Lying extension holding chains clipped to two handles; weight = chains.

name: Sled Overhead Triceps Extension
note: Handles on a rope/strap from a loaded sled, overhead extension facing away; weight = sled load.

name: Dip Machine
note: Seated dip machine; no dip-machine capability, mapped to triceps_ext_machine.

name: Triceps Dip
note: Upright torso, elbows in, on parallel bars (Chest Dip = forward lean).

name: Ring Dips
note: Dips on gymnastic rings.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
note: Hands narrower than shoulders, elbows tucked (not touching as in Diamond Push Up).

name: Incline Push-Up Close-Grip
note: Hands close on a bench or box.

name: Supine Chest Throw
note: Lying on the back, medicine ball thrown straight up from the chest and caught; ball weight not tracked.

name: Box Squat with Bands
note: Box squat with bands anchored low (rack base or heavy dumbbells); weight = bar only.

name: Box Squat with Chains
note: Box squat with chains on the sleeves; weight = bar plates.

name: Reverse Band Box Squat
note: Bands hung from the top of a power rack deload the bottom; needs a rack tall enough to anchor bands.

name: Reverse Band Power Squat
note: Powerlifting back squat with bands hung from the top of the rack.

name: Squat with Bands
note: Back squat with bands anchored low for accommodating resistance.

name: Squat with Chains
note: Back squat with chains on the sleeves.

name: Jefferson Squat
note: Straddle the bar lengthwise, one hand in front and one behind; lifted from the floor, no rack.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
note: Bar held at arm length behind the legs; lifted from the floor.

name: Overhead Squat
note: Snatch-grip bar overhead; can be snatched or jerked into place, so rack only recommended (like Push Press).

name: Jerk Dip Squat
note: Partial dip from the front rack, often overloaded; taken from a rack.

name: Barbell Side Split Squat
note: Wide stance, lowering to the side of the angled lead foot with the bar on the back; rack required (bar-on-body rule).

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
note: Bar on the back, so rack required; needs walking space.

name: Barbell Step Up
note: Bar on the back, so rack required; box or bench at about knee height.

name: Elevated Back Lunge
note: Deficit reverse lunge from a low platform (box/step or a plate) with the bar on the back.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (sztanga)
note: Rear-foot-elevated split squat with the bar on the back (barbell Bulgarian); rack per bar-on-body rule.

name: Weighted Jump Squat
note: Light barbell on the back; a vest or sandbag also works (not modelled).

name: Dumbbell Squat
note: Pair of dumbbells at the sides.

name: One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squat
note: One kettlebell locked out overhead; weight entered per side.

name: Smith Machine Pistol Squat
note: Single-leg squat under the Smith bar.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
note: Rear foot on a bench 2-3 ft behind the Smith machine (Bulgarian-style).

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
note: Lying under the Smith bar, pressing it with the feet; set the safeties.

name: Lying Machine Squat
note: Lying (supine) squat machine; no specific cap in the vocabulary, so generic lever machine.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
note: Leg extension machine one leg at a time.

name: Single-Leg High Box Squat
note: Single-leg squat standing on a high box, free leg hanging; band or rope above for balance optional.

name: Suspended Split Squat
note: Rear foot in a suspension-trainer strap.

name: Dip Belt Squat
note: Belt squat standing on two benches/boxes with plates hanging from a dip belt.

name: Band Squat
note: Standing on a band, ends held at the shoulders.

name: Hip Flexion with Band
note: Band anchored low behind, looped on the ankle; knee driven forward (hip flexors, rectus femoris).

name: Cable Deadlift
note: Standing between two low pulleys with one handle in each hand (squat-style pull).

name: Leverage Deadlift
note: Plate-loaded lever deadlift machine with handles at the sides (trap-bar-like).

name: One-Arm Side Deadlift
note: Suitcase deadlift: barbell held in the middle at the side, one hand; anti-lateral-flexion demand.

name: Hang Clean
note: Clean starting from the hang above the knees.

name: Clean Pull
note: Explosive pull from the floor with clean grip, no catch.

name: Block Clean
note: Pulling blocks are not in the vocabulary; boxes or rack safeties at the right height as stand-in.

name: Split Clean
note: Clean received in a split stance.

name: Barbell Snatch
note: Full barbell snatch from the floor; bumper plates ideal (not in vocabulary).

name: Block Snatch
note: Pulling blocks are not in the vocabulary; boxes or rack safeties at the right height as stand-in.

name: Block Power Snatch
note: Power (high) receive; pulling blocks not in vocabulary, boxes or rack safeties as stand-in.

name: Snatch Balance
note: Drop under the bar from the back into an overhead squat; taken from a rack.

name: Power Jerk
note: From the front rack (cleaned or from a rack), caught in a partial squat; rack recommended like Push Press.

name: Split Jerk
note: Jerk caught in a split stance; rack recommended like Push Press.

name: Squat Jerk
note: Jerk caught in a full overhead squat; rack recommended like Push Press.

name: Backward Drag
note: Walking backwards dragging a loaded sled by straps/rope; weight = plates on the sled.

name: Sled Drag (Harness)
note: Forward sled drag from a harness; dip/hip belt as closest cap (harness not in vocabulary).

name: Bear Crawl Sled Drag
note: Bear crawl facing away from the sled, chain on a harness or loose belt.

name: Yoke Walk
note: Strongman yoke carried on the back.

name: Conan's Wheel
note: Zercher-held lever arm walked in a circle; no cap for the strongman apparatus. Common substitute: loaded barbell in a landmine, held in the crook of the elbows and walked around the pivot.

name: Rickshaw Deadlift
note: Strongman rickshaw frame, neutral handles at the sides.

name: Tire Flip
note: Weight = tire weight; needs open space.

name: Sandbag Load
note: Lift the sandbag and load it onto a platform/box; often run over a distance.

name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
note: Plyometric bounding side to side; needs open space.

name: Bench Jump
note: Two-footed jumps over a bench or low box.

name: Alternate Leg Push-Off
note: Rapid alternating push-offs with one foot on a bench or box.

name: Single Leg Push-Off
note: Explosive push-off from one foot on a box, repeated on the same leg.

name: Single-Leg Stride Jump
note: Standing beside a box, inside foot on it; jump up driving the opposite knee.

name: Side to Side Box Shuffle
note: Jump across the box, alternating which foot is on top.

name: Depth Jump
note: Drop from one box and jump onto a second; needs two boxes (or box + bench).

name: Dumbbell Seated Box Jump
note: One dumbbell held at the chest, jump from seated on a bench onto a box.

name: Double Leg Butt Kick
note: Vertical jump kicking the heels to the glutes.

name: Single Leg Butt Kick
note: Single-leg vertical jump, heel kicked to the glute.

name: Split Jump
note: Jumping lunge switching legs in the air.

name: Star Jump
note: Explosive jump spreading arms and legs.

name: Side Standing Long Jump
note: Lateral broad jump; needs open space.

name: Front Cone Hops
note: Two-footed hops over a row of cones or small hurdles (any low objects; not in vocabulary).

name: Side Hop-Sprint
note: Lateral hops over a cone/hurdle, then a short sprint; needs open space; cone not in vocabulary.

name: Single-Leg Hop Progression
note: Single-leg hops forward over a line of cones (optional markers).

name: Single-Leg Lateral Hop
note: Lateral hops on one leg over a cone or line.

name: Fast Skipping
note: Running drill; needs open space.

name: Treadmill Walking
note: Flat or light-incline walking; steep incline is Incline Walk (bieżnia).

name: Band Good Morning
note: Band under the feet and over the upper back. Group plecy like Good Morning.

name: Band Hip Adduction
note: Standing, band from a post around the ankle, one leg at a time; rack or any sturdy anchor.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
note: Seated on a bench or box, bar across the knees (pad advised), toes on a block.

name: Box Skip
note: Plyometric skips onto boxes in a line; one box is enough for alternating skips. Group cardio like Box Jump.

name: Band Calf Raise
note: Standing on the band, handles held at the shoulders.

name: Carioca Quick Step
note: Lateral footwork/agility drill; needs some floor space.

name: Clean
note: Full (squat) barbell clean from the floor; bumper plates ideal (not in vocabulary).

name: Clean Deadlift
note: Deadlift in clean start position and grip; group plecy like Deadlift (sztanga).

name: Donkey Calf Raise
note: Donkey calf machine is not in the vocabulary; calf_machine is the closest capability. The old partner-on-the-hips version needs no machine.

name: Downward Facing Balance
note: Prone on a stability ball, hands on the floor, legs lifted and held straight.

name: Dumbbell Clean
note: Two dumbbells cleaned to the shoulders; weight per dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise
note: Seated, one dumbbell on one knee, toes on a block; one leg at a time.

name: Prone Flutter Kicks
note: Prone on a bench with hips at the edge, alternating straight-leg hip extension; not the supine ab flutter kick.

name: Good Morning off Pins
note: Dead-stop good morning from safety pins set at the bottom position; group plecy like Good Morning.

name: Hang Snatch
note: Barbell snatch from the hang, full squat catch. Covers the below-the-knee start too.

name: Hip Extension with Bands
note: Standing kickback with a band anchored low around one ankle; rack or any post as anchor.

name: Tuck Jump
note: Plyometric, no equipment.

name: Kneeling Jump Squat
note: From kneeling, explode to the feet with the bar on the back; unrack in a rack. Can be done unloaded.

name: Kneeling Squat
note: Kneeling hip extension with the bar on the back, set up in a rack with low safeties.

name: Lateral Bound
note: Plyometric side-to-side bounds, no equipment.

name: Lateral Box Jump
note: Sideways jumps onto/over a box.

name: Lateral Cone Hops
note: Side-to-side hops over a cone; cones are not in the vocabulary, any low object works.

name: Lunge Pass Through
note: Lunges passing one kettlebell under the front leg; a dumbbell works too.

name: Monster Walk
note: Bands around knees/ankles, short diagonal steps forward; sideways version is Lateral Band Walk.

name: Muscle Snatch
note: Snatch without rebending the knees; the arms pull and turn the bar over.

name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swings
note: One-arm version of Kettlebell Swing; a dumbbell works too.

name: Stability Ball Hip Bridge
note: Upper back on a stability ball, feet on the floor; unloaded hip-thrust variant.

name: Block Power Clean
note: Pulling blocks are not in the vocabulary; plyo boxes or rack safeties are the closest stand-ins.

name: Power Snatch
note: Barbell snatch from the floor, caught above parallel; bumper plates ideal (not in vocabulary).

name: Power Stairs
note: Strongman: implement lifted up a staircase; power stairs and the duck-walk implement are not in the vocabulary, box plus farmers handle/kettlebell/sandbag as stand-ins.

name: Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift
note: Bands hung from the top of a rack lighten the bottom of the sumo pull.

name: Seated Band Hamstring Curl
note: Seated on a bench, band anchored low in front behind the ankles.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raise
note: Toe raise with heels on a platform (works the tibialis anterior); the shin front has no region, so calves is used.

name: Smith Machine Stiff-Legged Deadlift
note: Stiff-legged deadlift in a Smith machine.

name: Snatch Deadlift
note: Deadlift with a snatch (wide) grip and start position.

name: Snatch Pull
note: Explosive snatch-grip pull to full extension with a shrug, no catch.

name: Split Snatch
note: Barbell snatch caught in a split stance.

name: Standing Leg Curl
note: Standing single-leg curl machine; the vocabulary has a single leg_curl capability, so machine types are not distinguished.

name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
note: From the floor with nearly straight knees, unlike RDL (sztanga) which starts from the top with soft knees.

name: Sumo Deadlift with Bands
note: Bands from the bar to the floor (platform pegs or heavy dumbbells) add load at lockout.

name: Sumo Deadlift with Chains
note: Chains hung on the bar add load at lockout.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
note: Floor, knees bent; side-to-side reach to the heels (lateral flexion).

name: Standing Barbell Rollout
note: Standing (from the feet) rollout on a barbell with round plates; harder than the kneeling Rollout (sztanga). Load is not lifted, so bodyweight.

name: Barbell Rollout from Bench
note: Kneeling on a flat bench, barbell with round plates on the floor in front; longer range than the floor rollout. Load is not lifted, so bodyweight.

name: Barbell Side Bend
note: Barbell across the upper back; rack recommended to unrack (light loads can be lifted into place).

name: Bent Press
note: One kettlebell (dumbbell is the historical implement, so OR'ed in); body bends under the bell, one side at a time.

name: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
fedb: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
note: Lying on a Bosu between two low pulleys, one handle in each hand; crunch with alternating side bends.

name: Butt-Ups
note: From a forearm plank, piking the hips up and back down.

name: Cable Judo Flip
note: Rope on a low pulley, side to the stack; rotational pull across the body, per side.

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
note: Ankle strap on a low pulley, lying on the floor facing away from the stack.

name: Cable Russian Twists
note: Handle on a mid pulley, upper back on a stability ball, rotating away from the stack.

name: Cable Seated Crunch
note: Seated on a flat bench, back to a high pulley, rope held at the head.

name: Cocoons
note: Floor; arms and knees meet over the torso (tuck V-up).

name: Cross-Body Crunch
note: Floor; elbow to the opposite knee, alternating sides.

name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
note: Floor; arms extended overhead lengthen the lever (a plate can be held).

name: Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball
note: Crunch on the floor with calves resting on a stability ball.

name: Decline Oblique Crunch
note: Decline bench with foot pads; twisting crunch to each side.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
note: Head at the top of a decline bench, gripping it; knees curled up toward the chest.

name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
note: One kettlebell overhead, the other picked up from the floor by the low hand; bells often differ in weight.

name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
note: Push-up position with shins on a stability ball, knees pulled toward the chest.

name: Frog Sit-Ups
note: Floor; soles together, knees out, which reduces hip-flexor help.

name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
note: Underhand hang; chin-up hold combined with a knee raise each rep.

name: Janda Sit-Up
note: Floor; glutes and hamstrings tensed (heels pulled down) to reduce hip-flexor contribution.

name: Kettlebell Figure 8
note: One kettlebell passed hand to hand around the legs in a hinge; a dumbbell works too.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
fedb: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
note: Kneeling cable crunch on a high pulley with the rope, twisting to alternate sides.

name: Leg Pull-In
note: Lying knee tuck from extended legs; mat or flat bench.

name: Medicine Ball Full Twist
note: Back to back with a partner, passing a medicine ball with a full rotation; needs a partner (not in the equipment vocabulary).

name: Oblique Crunches - On The Floor
note: Lying on the side, knees bent; lateral crunch.

name: One-Arm High-Pulley Cable Side Bends
note: Side to a high pulley, one handle overhead; side bend away from the stack.

name: One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam
note: One-arm version of Medicine Ball Slam; slam (non-bouncing) ball, per side.

name: Otis-Up
note: Sit-up holding a plate at the chest, pressing it overhead at the top; a dumbbell works too.

name: Pallof Press With Rotation
note: Pallof press at chest height, adding a controlled rotation away from the stack; per side.

name: Press Sit-Up
note: Decline bench with foot pads, light barbell on the chest pressed up as the torso rises.

name: Seated Barbell Twist
note: Seated on a bench end, light barbell across the upper back, rotating side to side.

name: Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
note: Seated on a bench edge leaning back, gripping its sides; knees pulled in as the torso comes forward.

name: Side Jackknife
note: Lying on the side, raising torso and legs toward each other (lateral V-up).

name: Sledgehammer Swings
note: Sledgehammer struck onto a tire; conditioning, reps per side or total.

name: Smith Machine Hip Raise
note: Lying on a bench in the Smith machine, feet against the bar; the bar is pressed up by raising the hips (loaded reverse crunch).

name: Spell Caster
note: Pair of dumbbells swept from one hip across and up past the opposite shoulder, rotating the trunk.

name: Spider Crawl
note: Low push-up position crawling forward, knee brought out toward the elbow each step; needs floor space.

name: Standing Rope Crunch
note: Standing, back to a high pulley, rope held at the head; standing version of Cable Crunch.

name: Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw
note: Sit-up with a one-arm medicine-ball throw; needs a wall or partner to throw to.

name: Supine Two-Arm Overhead Throw
note: Sit-up with a two-hand overhead medicine-ball throw; needs a wall or partner to throw to.

name: Suspended Fallout
note: Standing lean holding suspension handles (or rings), arms sliding overhead; like an ab wheel.

name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
note: Feet in suspension straps, push-up position, knees pulled to the chest.

name: Tuck Crunch
note: Floor; thighs vertical, ankles crossed, crunch with the legs held up.

name: Weighted Ball Side Bend
note: Side on a stability ball, plate held by the head; lateral crunch. Weight = plate or dumbbell.

name: Weighted Sit-Ups - With Bands
note: Bands anchored at the base of a decline bench, handles held at the shoulders; band resistance not logged as kg.

name: Ankle Circles
note: Standing on one leg, holding any support.

name: Supine Figure-Four Stretch
note: Lying figure-four (piriformis) stretch.

name: Arm Circles
note: Dynamic warm-up drill.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
note: Staggered stance, hands on a wall.

name: Cat-Cow
note: On all fours, round the spine.

name: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch
fedb: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch
note: Holding a stick or broomstick; a band also works. No stick capability in the vocabulary.

name: Chest Stretch on Stability Ball
note: Kneeling, elbow on a stability ball.

name: Child's Pose
note: Kneeling, sit back on the heels.

name: Chin To Chest Stretch
note: Seated, hands pull the head down.

name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
note: Bodyweight reverse lunge with a torso rotation; dynamic warm-up drill.

name: Seated Rotation Stretch
note: Seated, one leg crossed over, spinal twist.

name: Dynamic Back Stretch
note: Straight-arm swings overhead; dynamic.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
note: Exaggerated clapping motion; dynamic.

name: Standing Chest Stretch
note: Standing, hands on lower back, elbows pulled back.

name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
note: Front-back leg swings holding any support.

name: Butterfly Stretch
note: Seated butterfly with a forward lean.

name: Groiners
note: From push-up position, hop feet to hands; dynamic drill.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
note: Lying, strap around the foot. Belt, rope or band as a strap.

name: Hip Circles (Prone)
note: On all fours, circle the knee.

name: IT Band and Glute Stretch
note: Lying, straight leg across the body with a strap. Belt, rope or band as a strap.

name: Inchworm
note: Walk hands out to a plank and back; dynamic drill.

name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
note: Lying, leg out to the side with a strap. Belt, rope or band as a strap.

name: Iron Crosses (Stretch)
note: Prone scorpion: leg across the back; dynamic.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
note: Lying spinal twist.

name: Knee Circles
note: Standing, knees together, circle the knees.

name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
note: Kneeling, palms flat with fingers back.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
note: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch.

name: Middle Back Stretch
note: Standing torso twist.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
note: Side-lying quad and hip flexor stretch.

name: Wall Lat Stretch
note: Bent arm on a wall or door frame.

name: One Knee To Chest
note: Lying, one knee to chest.

name: Overhead Stretch
note: Standing, arms overhead, fingers laced.

name: Peroneals Stretch
note: Seated, foot inverted with a strap. Belt, rope or band as a strap.

name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
note: Seated, foot everted with a strap. Belt, rope or band as a strap.

name: Round The World Shoulder Stretch
note: Shoulder dislocates with a stick or broomstick; a band also works. No stick capability in the vocabulary.

name: Runner's Stretch
note: Low lunge, hands on the floor.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
note: Seated, one leg extended, pull the toes.

name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch
note: Seated, one leg extended, foot of the other on the inner thigh.

name: Shoulder Circles
note: Shoulder rolls.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
note: Cross-body arm stretch.

name: Leg Swings (Side-to-Side)
note: Lateral leg swings holding any support.

name: Side Lying Groin Stretch
note: Side-lying, top leg raised and held.

name: Side Neck Stretch
note: Lateral head tilt.

name: Standing Biceps Stretch
note: Hands clasped behind the back, arms raised.

name: Standing Elevated Quad Stretch
note: Rear foot on a bench or step; a chair or couch also works.

name: Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch
note: Heel on a step, knee straight, reach for the toes; any step or curb works.

name: Standing Hip Circles
note: Standing on one leg holding any support, circle the knee.

name: Standing Lateral Stretch
note: Standing side bend.

name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
note: Standing pelvic tilts.

name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
note: Standing, both knees bent, rear heel down.

name: Standing Toe Touches
note: Standing forward fold.

name: The Straddle
note: Seated straddle forward lean.

name: Torso Rotation
note: Standing rotations holding a ball at arm's length; mobility drill, not loaded.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
note: Overhead, pull the elbow behind the head.

name: Upper Back Stretch
note: Hands clasped forward, shoulders rounded.

name: Lying Leg Crossover Swings
note: Lying, leg swung across the body; dynamic.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
note: Lunge with elbow drop and rotation; dynamic warm-up.

name: Wrist Circles
note: Arms out to the sides, circle the wrists.

name: Adductor-SMR
note: Foam rolling, inner thigh.

name: Calves-SMR
note: Foam rolling.

name: Foam Roll: Hamstrings
note: Foam rolling.

name: Iliotibial Tract-SMR
note: Foam rolling, IT band / outer thigh.

name: Latissimus Dorsi-SMR
note: Foam rolling.

name: Peroneals-SMR
note: Foam rolling, outer lower leg.

name: Piriformis-SMR
note: Foam rolling, figure-four seated on the roller.

name: Foam Roll: Quadriceps
note: Foam rolling.

name: Rhomboids-SMR
note: Foam rolling, upper back.

name: Foot-SMR
note: Original uses a foot roller, PVC pipe or ball under the arch; foam roller is the closest capability. Plantar fascia mapped to calves (no foot region).

name: Frog Hops
note: Consecutive forward squat jumps; plyometric (like Jump Squat).

name: Lower Back Curl
note: Prone back extension lifting only the chest, arms out to the sides (Superman lifts arms and legs).

name: Stomach Vacuum
note: Isometric draw-in of the abdomen after full exhale (transversus abdominis).

name: Scissor Kick
note: Lying, legs low and alternately crossed; same pattern as Lying Leg Raise.

name: Toe Touchers
note: Lying, legs vertical, crunch up reaching for the toes.
